title: Mrs. Miller's house
subtitle: A note on the fridge — instructions and directions
canDo: I can understand and give simple instructions: Open…, Don't…
I can give simple directions: turn left, go straight.
I can write a short note for a friend.
teacherNotes: Ünitenin son dersi: "Write a note" görevini ödev verin. Not türü gerçek hayatta çok kullanılır (buzdolabı notu, mesaj).
Emir kipini sınıf talimatlarıyla bağlayın: Listen, Read, Write, Match… hepsi emir cümlesi! Öğrenciler bunu fark edince çok hoşlarına gider.
Arap öğrencilere: İngilizcede emir tek biçimli (افتح / افتحي / افتحوا → open). Türk öğrencilere: olumsuzda "not" değil "don't".
Yol tarifi oyunu: Ekranda basit bir harita çizin; öğrenciler birbirlerine "Turn left…" diyerek yol tarif etsin.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: A note on the fridge
sections.intro: Rose leaves a note for Elif.
paragraphs: Please feed Tom at 8 a.m. and 6 p.m.
His food is in the cupboard next to the fridge.
Give him fresh water every day.
He loves them, but they aren't good for him.
Please water the plants in the living room on Saturday.
There's lemonade in the fridge for you.

sections.title: Grammar: instructions (imperatives)
rules: Instruction = the verb first, no subject: **Open** the door.
Add **please** to be polite: **Please** water the plants.
Directions: **turn** left, **turn** right, **go** straight, **walk** to the park

support.tr: Emir cümlesi fiille başlar, özne yoktur: Open the window = Pencereyi aç. Olumsuz için Don't kullanılır: Don't open the window = Pencereyi açma. Kibar olmak için please ekle: Please water the plants = Lütfen çiçekleri sula. Yol tarifi de böyle yapılır: Turn left = Sola dön. Derslerdeki talimatlar da emir cümlesidir: Listen, Read, Write!
support.ar: فعل الأمر يبدأ بالفعل مباشرةً بدون فاعل: Open the window = افتح النافذة. وللنهي نستخدم Don't: Don't open the window = لا تفتح النافذة. ولنكون مؤدّبين نضيف please: Please water the plants = من فضلك اسقِ النباتات. لاحظ: شكل الأمر واحد في الإنجليزية للمذكّر والمؤنّث والجمع (افتح، افتحي، افتحوا = open).

tr.note: Olumsuz emirde not ya da no değil, don't kullan.

ar.note: بعد Don't يأتي الفعل مباشرةً بدون to، ولا نستخدم no للنهي.

sections.title: Write: A note

model.heading: Elif's note for Zeynep
text: Hi Zeynep! Welcome to my apartment.
The keys are on the table next to the door.
Please water the plants on Sunday.
Don't open the window — Rose's cat is next door!

sections.prompt: Your friend is in your home this weekend. Write a note: where things are and 4 or 5 instructions. Send it to your teacher.

support.tr: Arkadaşın bu hafta sonu senin evinde kalıyor. Bir not yaz: eşyalar nerede ve 4–5 talimat. Notu öğretmenine gönder.
support.ar: صديقك في بيتك هذا الأسبوع. اكتب ملاحظة: أين الأشياء، و4 أو 5 تعليمات. أرسلها إلى معلّمك.
